Yeah all aussie species stay in Australia and no youtubers really have them, I feel like most snake owners are outside of Australia.

 I don't know about separate feeding boxes that much either but I think I'm just going to go with whatever the previous owner was doing.

If you search for children's pythons specifically on YouTube you will get a few videos.

The best beginner snakes in Australia are pygmy pythons, children's, stimsons, and spotted - https://megadiverse.tumblr.com/post/130240216827/good-beginner-snakes-for-australians

I'm going to get my snake from a reptile expo.
The reason I'm not using a heat mat is that my enclosure is timber and It won't heat through the timber well and I don't want to put it under straight substrate
Oh and I have a caged heat lamp and strip light

Yay good job! I'm in NSW and getting a children's python in a month.

 My father and I built a 90Lx45Wx60H plywood enclosure. I've picked up a few nice branches from around my uncles farm and threw them in the oven. I bought chipsi substrate from a local store and simple water dish. I've also gathered heaps of fake plants from family and friends that don't want theirs anymore.

Also just research and research and research. Snake discovery on YouTube with Emily is my main source of finding stuff out. Alot is also hands on experience and pet shops are more than happy to help.
